page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.36xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor with 144 dedicated vCPUs operating at a 3.4 GHz clock speed. The server features 768.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 5.33 GB of RAM per vCPU without hardware-level vector or matrix acceleration extensions enabled in the profile.

Network communication is supported by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface. The instance does not include integrated local storage disks, requiring external block storage for persistent filesystem operations. It does not package discrete GPU accelerators or include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, focusing physical host resources strictly on high-density central processing and large RAM allocation.

Given the high CPU clock speed and substantial parallel compute capacity, ecs.hfg9i.36xlarge is configured for compute-intensive and concurrent tasks requiring rapid core frequency. Suitable workloads include large-scale software compilation, distributed simulations, batch processing jobs, and high-load backend application serving requiring significant memory headroom alongside dedicated CPU cycles.
